name: pi-web-x
description: Bun-native web UI for the pi coding agent

scripts.dev: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun run scripts/build-css.ts && mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun --watch src/cli.ts -- --no-open
scripts.dev:lan: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun run scripts/build-css.ts && mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun --watch src/cli.ts -- -H 0.0.0.0 --no-open
scripts.build: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun run scripts/build-css.ts && mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/cli.ts --asset ./public --outfile dist/pi-web-x
scripts.build:all: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun run scripts/build-all.ts
scripts.start: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun run scripts/build-css.ts && mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun src/cli.ts
scripts.start:lan: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun run scripts/build-css.ts && mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun src/cli.ts -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.test:bun: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun test tests --path-ignore-patterns='**/e2e/**'
scripts.release: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun run scripts/build-all.ts
scripts.test:e2e: mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bun run build && mise exec bun@1.4.0 -- bunx playwright test
